content:
**Monongah Power Substation MZ-02** is a location in the Savage Divide region of Appalachia.

Located southeast of The Whitespring Resort, this substation once served the Monongah Power Plant, distributing power throughout Appalachia. After the Great War, the substation was occupied by a group of Raiders. In 2102, they no longer inhabit the location, but left behind some ramshackle defensive structures. [1] 

The substation consists of various electrical equipment enclosed behind a fenced area. In the northeast corner lies a metal shack that may spawn a random Camp Plan. Just outside to the north is a small elevated fort where one can find two Banjos. To the southwest lies another fortification. Atop the stairs is an Ammo Box. Against the cliff face to the south are a few Aluminum Veins.

If the player character builds their C.A.M.P. near the substation, they will be able to connect a power cable to the substation's power outlet. If the Powering Up Monongah event has been completed, the power output will increase.

Monongah Power Substation MZ-02 appears in *Fallout 76*.
